name: Brian Schimmel

bio.statement: A 2026 Capital Chronicle commentary says the Independent Party nominated Schimmel, a Forest Grove city council member active in area nonprofit groups.
bio.excerpt: The IPO has nominated Brian Schimmel of Forest Grove, a city council member there and long active in area non-profit groups.

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Schimmel lists his occupation as city councilor and small business owner, with a background including a family dairy farm, Intel Corporation, Centro Cultural and nonprofit boards.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: City Councilor; Small Business Owner - Capital Project Manager, Asset Management Specialist Occupational Background: Family Dairy Farm; Intel Corporation; Centro Cultural; Non-profit Board Leadership

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 50

bio.statement: Schimmel lists a B.S. from Oregon State University and Naval Reserve Officer Training Corps.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: B.S., Oregon State University; Naval Reserve Officer Training Corps.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 50

bio.statement: Schimmel lists the Urban Renewal Agency Board, the TV Highway Transit and Safety Project committee, the Economic Development Commission and chairing the Sustainability Commission.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Urban Renewal Agency Board; Tualatin Valley (TV) Highway Transit & Safety Project Policy & Budget Committee (P&B); Economic Development Commission and Chamber of Commerce Board Liaison; Sustainability Commission Chair

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 50
